Awesome AI Dropouts

I want to encourage more AI students to choose their own path.

This page collects examples of AI researchers who left degree programs in China and continued their studies abroad. Each entry links to their homepage and public sources documenting their experience.

Help build this list: email me with suggested researchers, corrections, and supporting links.

Please include public sources documenting the experience. If none exist and you are submitting someone else's case, provide at least one referee other than yourself who can confirm it.

Listed roughly from younger to older, using undergraduate cohorts where birth years are unavailable.

01

Lin Long

Left his master's program at Zhejiang University. Now a PhD student at Johns Hopkins University working on multimodal and embodied AI.

02

Longqian Huang

Withdrew from a neurobiology PhD at Zhejiang University, then began an electrical engineering PhD at Caltech in 2024. His research combines deep learning, computational imaging, and optical microscopy.

03

Tianjian Meng

Transferred out of Beijing Jiaotong University to study computer science at Pittsburgh, later entering a PhD program at UT Austin. His work covers computer vision and efficient deep learning.

  • Transfer record (CV) ↗
04

Chunfeng Lian

Left Xidian University's integrated master's–PhD program without completing it, then earned a computer science PhD at Université de Technologie de Compiègne. Now a Xi'an Jiaotong University professor working on medical AI and neuroimaging.

05

Xueyi Zou

Left Beihang University's software engineering PhD program in 2012 and completed a computer science PhD at York. His research includes computer vision, deep learning, SLAM, robot planning, and autonomous-system validation.

06

Hongsheng Li

Left his master's program at Shanghai Jiao Tong University to pursue a PhD at Lehigh. Now a CUHK professor working on computer vision and embodied AI.

07

Kai Liu

Left UESTC's computer science master's program without completing it and earned a PhD at City University of Hong Kong. Now a Chongqing University professor working on edge intelligence, embodied intelligence, and autonomous driving.

08

Tianshi Chen

Withdrew in his fourth year of Harbin Institute of Technology's integrated master's–PhD program and moved to CUHK for a PhD. His research focuses on system identification, statistical modeling, and data-driven control.

09

Xiaole Shirley Liu

Transferred from Peking University to Smith College, then earned a biomedical informatics PhD at Stanford. A computational biologist known for MACS and Cistrome, she became a Harvard professor before leaving in 2022 to lead GV20 Therapeutics.

Song-Chun Zhu

Left his master's program at USTC and later earned a PhD at Harvard. Now a Peking University professor working on computer vision and general AI.
